{{Short description|British mathematician (born 1949)}}
Professor '''John C. Wood''' (born 1949) is a British mathematician working at the [[University of Leeds]].<ref>[http://www.maths.leeds.ac.uk/people.html Faculty profile] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171017113730/http://www.maths.leeds.ac.uk/people.html |date=2017-10-17 }}, University of Leeds, retrieved 2015-02-02.</ref>  He is one of the leading experts on [[harmonic map]]s and [[harmonic morphism]]s in the field of [[differential geometry]].<ref>[http://www.matematik.lu.se/matematiklu/personal/sigma/Bull.%20London%20Math.%20Soc.-2006-Gudmundsson-869-72.pdf Book Review], Bulletin of the London Mathematical Society '''38''' (2006), 869-872.</ref>

Wood is a coauthor of the monograph: ''Harmonic Morphisms Between Riemannian Manifolds''.  This was published in 2003 and is still the standard text on the subject.<ref>{{cite book|url=http://ukcatalogue.oup.com/product/9780198503620.do|title=Harmonic Morphisms Between Riemannian Manifolds|publisher=Oxford University Press|series=London Mathematical Society Monographs |date=29 May 2003 |isbn=978-0-19-850362-0 }}</ref>

Wood earned his PhD from the [[University of Warwick]] in 1974, under the supervision of [[James Eells]]. His doctoral students have included [[Sigmundur Gudmundsson]] and [[Stefano Montaldo]].<ref>{{mathgenealogy|id=19866}}</ref>

==Plagiarism==
Wood was at the centre of a plagiarism row with another of his former PhD students in 2011.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.timeshighereducation.com/news/alumnus-spurns-phd-over-plagiarism-row/421271.article|title=Alumnus Spurns Ph.D.over Plagiarism Row|work=Times Higher Education|date=27 September 2012 }}</ref>
